descriptions.smtp: The relay every notification leaves through. Without it nothing reaches a customer and nobody can be sent a password reset.
descriptions.fx: A daily rate for each currency marked tracked. Nothing prices from the feed — a charge line keeps the rate it was struck at.
descriptions.carrierPoll: How often the poll asks, and how many shipments each run covers. Calls per hour has to stay under the carrier’s cap.
descriptions.carrierTracking: Where container milestones come from. The carriers publish their own events — free, self-serve, one registration each.
descriptions.carrierMaersk: Covers MAEU, MAEI, MCPU, SEAU and SEJJ. Registration is self-serve at developer.maersk.com.
descriptions.carrierHapag: Covers HLCU and HLXU, and takes an id as well as a secret. Registration is self-serve at api.hlag.com.
descriptions.carrierCmacgm: Covers CMDU, ANNU, APLU and CHNL. Registration is self-serve at apis.cma-cgm.net.
descriptions.whatsapp: WhatsApp through Kapso — the account key that sends replies and receives inbound enquiries. Off by default, and email is the fallback. The numbers each branch answers on are set under Settings › WhatsApp numbers.
descriptions.einvoice: The accredited provider that files an invoice with the tax authority. We are not the access point and cannot be.
descriptions.inboundEmail: The shared secret a mail provider signs its forwarding webhook with. Separate from the mailboxes this system reads itself.
descriptions.ai: Reads supplier invoices and scans into structured rows for a person to confirm. The key switches it on; leave the model blank for the default. Billed per document, and an unread bill is simply one that gets typed.
descriptions.fileStore: Where every stored document lives — the rendered invoices, the bills of lading, the scans that arrive by mail. Without it documents render but cannot be kept.
descriptions.rateAutoFanout: Fan an RFQ out to every covering agent the moment an enquiry has a resolvable lane, once, with no coordinator's click. It emails real agents, so it stays off until switched on.
descriptions.enquiryAutoAccept: Apply what a model reads off an enquiry email without a coordinator's click — but only above the confidence set here, only where the field is still empty, and never for an ambiguous port or commodity, which stay in the queue for a person.
descriptions.rateAutoPromote: Promote the cheapest agent reply into a buy rate card without a coordinator's click. Choose when it commits: as soon as one reply parses, once every agent has answered, or after a wait window.
descriptions.quoteAutoDraft: Once a buy rate is awarded and the lane is covered, draft the quotation against the customer's house margin and its covering note — as a draft. It never sends; a person reviews and puts it in front of the customer.
